title: 応用バイオ専門実験・演習Ｂ
subtitle: Applied Bioscience Major Lab/Exercises B
teachers:
NOMURA Kazuki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Students will learn the skills related to experimental operations, instrument handling, instrumental analysis, data analysis, and report preparation in bioscience. Students will acquire the ability to qualitatively and quantitatively evaluate the results obtained from the experiments, and to think logically. Through experiments and exercises practicing theories and methods, students will acquire comprehension and application ability based on a basic foundation.
advice:
Students will carry out experiments and exercises based on the topics in bioscience. If components are difficult to understand in experiments and exercises, students will be asked to work on the topic before the next class through research and asking the instructor and other classmates questions.
Basics: Experimental guidance, safety training, exam
Genetic experiments: DNA Extraction, Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR), Restriction enzyme treatment,
Transformation, Agarose gel electrophoresis
Protein research: Protein quantification assay, SDS-PAGE
Enzyme research: Enzyme activity, Optimum pH, Optimum temperature
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of the fundamentals of bioscience, such as molecular cloning and biochemistry.

activityGoals.body: Handle instruments and equipment safely and explain the outline of experimental arrangements.
Read instructions that use technical terms and carry out your own experiments.
Understand the theoretical background and logically examine the experimental results.

              Students will learn the skills related to experimental operations, instrument handling, instrumental analysis, data analysis, and report preparation in bioscience. Students will acquire the ability to qualitatively and quantitatively evaluate the results obtained from the experiments, and to think logically. Through experiments and exercises practicing theories and methods, students will acquire comprehension and application ability based on a basic foundation.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Students will carry out experiments and exercises based on the topics in bioscience. If components are difficult to understand in experiments and exercises, students will be asked to work on the topic before the next class through research and asking the instructor and other classmates questions.
Basics: Experimental guidance, safety training, exam
Genetic experiments: DNA Extraction, Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR), Restriction enzyme treatment,
Transformation, Agarose gel electrophoresis
Protein research: Protein quantification assay, SDS-PAGE
Enzyme research: Enzyme activity, Optimum pH, Optimum temperature
